description.value: Lee's Donuts is a beloved BC institution founded in 1979 at Granville Island Public Market, now expanded to multiple locations including Lower Lonsdale in North Vancouver. All donuts are handmade fresh daily in small batches from scratch using the original recipes developed by founders Alan and Betty Lee. The shop has earned a cult following over 45+ years and has been featured on Netflix.
